function_signature: def checktree(self, preorder, inorder, postorder, N)
prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the GeeksforGeeks problem 'Check Tree Traversal'. Given preorder, inorder and postorder traversals of a binary tree of size N, determine whether they correspond to the same tree.
actual_output: Runtime Error for larger inputs due to recursion overhead

bug_analysis.bug_description: The algorithm reconstructs the tree using recursive calls with Python list slicing. This causes additional memory usage and increased runtime for larger inputs.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Using array slicing inside recursive calls instead of index boundaries.
bug_analysis.bug_location: build() helper function when splitting preorder and inorder arrays
